scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Hm? You're... What is it about you? I've been an honorable Knight for a long time, but I cannot understand this feeling I'm getting from you...
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
嗯？你是……你身上有什么特别之处吗？我作为一名光荣的骑士已经很久了，但我无法理解从你身上感受到的这种感觉……

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Ah, a member of our Chivalry.
I hope you are living up to my expectations. We have vowed to be strong for our kingdom, even if death is upon us...
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
啊，是我们骑士团的一员。
我希望你没有辜负我的期望。我们曾发誓，即使死亡降临，也要为了王国变得强大……

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Welcome,
this is the
Prontera Chivalry.
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
欢迎，
这里是
普隆德拉骑士团。
你有什么事吗？

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Welcome. We, the proud Knights of the Prontera Chivalry, will give our lives for king and country! Please enjoy your stay.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
欢迎。我们，骄傲的普隆德拉骑士团成员，将为国王和国家献出生命！请在这里过得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Welcome, this is
the Prontera Chivalry.
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
欢迎，这里是
普隆德拉骑士团。
你有什么事吗？

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Mmm?
{0},
what can I do for you?
Ah, you don't know
who to visit?
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
嗯？
{0}，
我能为你做些什么？
啊，你不知道
该去找谁？

scripts.text: [Captain Herman]
scripts.translation: [船长 赫尔曼]

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Finish the last test.
Once that is complete, all the Knights involved in your testing shall gather, and we will evaluate your performance.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
完成最后的测试。
一旦完成，所有参与你测试的骑士都将聚集在一起，我们将评估你的表现。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Oh...!
You cannot change jobs if you have unused skill points remaining. Return once you have distributed all your skill points.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
哦……！
如果你还有未分配的技能点数，就无法更换职业。等你分配完所有技能点数后再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Oh, have you completed all the tests? But not everyone who completes the tests can
become a Knight.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
哦，你已经完成了所有测试吗？但并不是所有完成测试的人都能
成为骑士。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
May god bless your body and soul, warrior. I hope you will show your courage and protect those who are weaker than you.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
愿神保佑你的身心，战士。希望你能展现勇气，保护那些比你弱小的人。

scripts.text: I want to change my job to Swordman.
scripts.translation: 我想转职为剑士。

scripts.text: I want to change my job to a Knight.
scripts.translation: 我想转职为骑士。

scripts.text: Just visiting.
scripts.translation: 只是来看看。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
A-ha~
A Swordman, you say?
I'm sorry, {0}, but you've
come to the wrong place!
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
啊哈~
你说你是剑士？
抱歉，{0}，但你
来错地方了！

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
This isn't the Swordsman guild, it's the Prontera Chivalry! If you wish to become a Swordman, visit the Swordman Guild located in Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
这里不是剑士公会，而是普隆德拉骑士团！如果你想成为剑士，请去位于依斯鲁得岛的剑士公会。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Ah, I see that you have great ambition. But you must first become a Swordman before becoming
a Knight. One step at a time...
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
啊，我看你很有雄心壮志。但在成为骑士之前，你必须先成为剑士。一步一步来……

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
First, visit the Swordman guild in Izlude. Then, come visit us again once you have become a well experienced Swordman.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
首先，去依斯鲁得岛的剑士公会。然后，当你成为一名经验丰富的剑士后，再来拜访我们。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Aha~
You must have lots of free time. Why don't you go hunt some monsters instead of wandering about aimlessly?
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
啊哈~
你一定有很多空闲时间。与其漫无目的地闲逛，不如去猎杀一些魔物怎么样？

scripts.text:
Welcome, this is
the Prontera Chivalry.
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
欢迎，这里是
普隆德拉骑士团。
你有什么事吗？

scripts.text: I want to change my job to a Knight.
scripts.translation: 我想转职为骑士。

scripts.text: Just visiting.
scripts.translation: 只是来看看。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Ohh...
A young {0} who wishes
to become a Knight!
Our Prontera Chivalry
will assist you.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
哦……
一位希望
成为骑士的年轻{0}！
我们普隆德拉骑士团
会协助你。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
First of all, I am the captain of the Prontera Chivalry, Herman Phon Efesirsus. I'm pleased to meet young people eager to join the Prontera Chivalry.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
首先，我是普隆德拉骑士团的团长，赫尔曼·冯·埃费西尔苏斯。很高兴见到渴望加入普隆德拉骑士团的年轻人。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
We only accept Swordmen
who are at least Job Level 40.
We cannot consider applicants that are not yet experienced enough to become Knights.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
我们只接受
职业等级至少为40级的剑士。
我们无法考虑那些经验不足以成为骑士的申请者。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Once you apply, and we find
you eligible, we will begin the job change procedure. Would you
like to apply now?
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
一旦你申请，并且我们发现你符合条件，我们将开始转职程序。你想
现在申请吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I would like to apply.
scripts.translation: 是的，我想申请。

scripts.text: I'd like to think about it please.
scripts.translation: 我想再考虑一下。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Ah, you are not yet ready to become a Knight! Didn't I specifically mention the Job Level 40 requirement?
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
啊，你还没有准备好成为骑士！我不是特别提到了职业等级40级的要求吗？

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Ah...!
You cannot change jobs if you have unused skill points remaining. Return when you have used
all of your skill points.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
啊……！
如果你还有未分配的技能点数，就无法更换职业。等你用完
所有技能点数后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Let me see...
Your name is
{0}...
Is that right?
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
让我看看……
你的名字是
{0}……
对吗？

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Of course I understand your strong desire to join us, but now is not the time. Go out and fight some more monsters. We will be here waiting.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
当然，我理解你强烈想要加入我们的愿望，但现在还不是时候。出去多战斗一些魔物吧。我们会在这里等待。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Let me explain the job change procedure. You must visit a series of Knights and pass each
of their tests.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
让我解释一下转职程序。你必须依次拜访几位骑士，并通过他们各自的测试。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Once all the tests are completed, every Knight involved in your testing will gather and discuss your performance.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
一旦所有测试完成，所有参与你测试的骑士将聚集在一起，讨论你的表现。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
The Knights must unanimously approve of you before you can join the Prontera Chivalry. If only one person objects, you must
start over.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
骑士们必须一致同意你才能加入普隆德拉骑士团。如果只有一个人反对，你就必须
重新开始。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
But I believe if you persist with an earnest heart, you shall be acknowledged by the Knights and ultimately recognized as a member of our Chivalry.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
但我相信，如果你以真诚的心坚持下去，你将得到骑士们的认可，并最终被承认为我们骑士团的一员。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
So, let's not waste any more time talking! Go and meet these Knights and begin their tests. Once you have completed all of the tests, come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
所以，让我们不要再浪费时间交谈了！去见见这些骑士并开始他们的测试吧。一旦你完成了所有测试，就回到我这里来。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Oh...!
Well, I don't want to pressure you. Take your time and think it over. Return when you are ready to
change jobs, for we will be waiting.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
哦……！
好吧，我不想给你压力。慢慢考虑清楚。当你准备好
转职时再回来，因为我们会等待。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Come to think of it, aren't you a Swordman? It looks like you've encountered many foes in battle.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
说起来，你不就是那个剑士吗？看起来你在战斗中遇到了不少敌人。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
You should consider changing jobs to a Knight. Come and talk to me if you are interested.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
你应该考虑转职为骑士。如果你感兴趣，就来和我谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Please take
your time in
looking around.
Good day.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
请慢慢
参观。
再见。

scripts.text:
Mmm?
{0},
what can I do for you?
Ah, you don't know
who to visit?
scripts.translation:
嗯？
{0}，
我能为你做些什么？
啊，你不知道
该去找谁？

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
I believe the Knights in charge of testing have set an order in which you must visit them. I suppose it helps the testing process.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
我相信负责测试的骑士们已经设定了你必须拜访他们的顺序。我想这有助于测试过程。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
First, go and visit
Sir Andrew for your first test. Don't be too nervous, he'll explain everything once you talk to him.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
首先，去拜访
安德鲁爵士进行第一次测试。别太紧张，你一和他说话，他就会解释一切。

scripts.text: It appears that you have finished one test. Let's see. Sir Andrew, who must this Swordman visit next?
scripts.translation: 看来你已经完成了一项测试。让我看看。安德鲁爵士，这位剑士接下来必须去拜访谁？

scripts.text:
[Sir Andrew]
I said to
visit Sir Siracuse.
Funny, I thought I told
you. Did I forget...?
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
我说去
拜访西拉库斯爵士。
真奇怪，我以为我告诉
过你了。是我忘了吗……？

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Did you hear?
Go to Sir Siracuse and take his test. Once you complete his test, do not forget who you're supposed to visit next as well.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
你听到了吗？
去西拉库斯爵士那里接受他的测试。完成他的测试后，也不要忘记你接下来应该去拜访谁。

scripts.text:
Let's see...
You've completed two tests.
Sir Siracuse, who must this Swordman visit next?
scripts.translation:
让我看看……
你已经完成了两项测试。
西拉库斯爵士，这位剑士接下来必须去拜访谁？

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Oh...!
Um, who was next...?
Right! Sir Windsor!
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
哦……！
嗯，下一个是谁……？
对了！温莎爵士！

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Head over to
Sir Windsor Benedict for your next test. Listen carefully to the Knights in charge of testing so that you don't feel lost, alright?
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
前往下一个测试地点，
温莎·本尼迪克特爵士。仔细听负责测试的骑士的话，这样你就不会感到迷茫，好吗？

scripts.text:
Sir Windor...?
Who must this
Swordman visit
next?
scripts.translation:
温多尔爵士……？
这位
剑士接下来
必须去拜访谁？

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...
......

[Sir Windsor]
...Amy Beatrice.
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...艾米·贝阿特丽丝。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Ah, go and visit
Lady Amy and take her test. Make sure you pay attention to who you must go to for your next test.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
啊，去拜访
艾米女士并接受她的测试。务必注意你接下来必须去拜访谁。

scripts.text:
Let's see...
Lady Amy, who
must this Swordman
visit next?
scripts.translation:
让我看看……
艾米女士，
这位剑士
接下来必须去拜访谁？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Oh...
I said to visit
Sir Edmond!
Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
哦……
我说去拜访
埃德蒙爵士！
嘻嘻~

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Now, go and speak
to Sir Edmond. He will
be in charge of your
next test.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
现在，去和
埃德蒙爵士谈谈。他将
负责你的
下一次测试。

scripts.text:
Don't you only have to visit one more person? The Knight in
charge of the final test
is Sir Gray Prospheiro.
scripts.translation:
你不是只需要再拜访一个人吗？负责最终测试的骑士是
格雷·普罗斯菲罗爵士。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
This world operates according
to the law of cause and effect.
All will be revealed in the end.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
这个世界根据
因果律运作。
一切终将被揭示。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Be alert and do
your best, as this
is the last test.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
保持警惕并
全力以赴，因为这是
最后一次测试。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Return to me
after you have
completed the
final test.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
完成
最终测试后
回到我这里。

scripts.text:
Finish the last test.
Once that is complete, all the Knights involved in your testing shall gather, and we will evaluate your performance.
scripts.translation:
完成最后的测试。
一旦完成，所有参与你测试的骑士都将聚集在一起，我们将评估你的表现。

scripts.text:
Oh...!
You cannot change jobs if you have unused skill points remaining. Return once you have distributed all your skill points.
scripts.translation:
哦……！
如果你还有未分配的技能点数，就无法更换职业。等你分配完所有技能点数后再回来吧。

scripts.text:
Oh, have you completed all the tests? But not everyone who completes the tests can
become a Knight.
scripts.translation:
哦，你已经完成了所有测试吗？但并不是所有完成测试的人都能
成为骑士。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
During the test we see how loyal, honorable and strong you are. We also see if you were courteous and if you know the value of modesty and reverence.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
在测试中，我们要看你是否忠诚、高尚和强大。我们还要看你是否有礼貌，以及是否懂得谦逊和敬畏的价值。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Through this process, I have also observed your actions. All seven of our opinions will be reflected in the decision of your job change.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
在这个过程中，我也观察了你的行动。我们七个人的意见都将反映在你转职的决定中。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Then...
We shall listen
to everyone's thoughts!
Andrew, what do you think?
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
那么……
我们将听取
每个人的想法！
安德鲁，你怎么看？

scripts.text:
[Sir Andrew]
What can I say?
I approve!
Having lived as
a Swordsman up
until now
is enough.
scripts.translation:
[安德鲁爵士]
我还能说什么呢？
我批准！
到目前为止
作为剑士的生活
已经足够了。

scripts.text:
[Sir Andrew]
This one has
gathered items
that are troublesome
to obtain. I approve!
I believe {0}he will continue to be loyal after becoming a Knight.
scripts.translation:
[安德鲁爵士]
这个人收集了
难以获得的物品。我批准！
我相信{0}他在成为骑士后会继续保持忠诚。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Hmm.
What a nice review.
Siracuse, what are your thoughts?
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
嗯。
多么好的评价。
西拉库斯，你有什么想法？

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Heh, very well. Not quite what
I would want, but hopefully will become better in the future.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
嘿，很好。虽然不完全是我想要的，但希望未来会变得更好。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
After becoming a Knight, you must build a good reputation through honor. Ehh... I approve.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
成为骑士后，你必须通过荣誉建立良好的声誉。呃……我批准。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Okay...
Windsor,
what about you?
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
好的……
温莎，
你呢？

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...
......

[Sir Windsor]
....Approved.
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
....批准。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
I don't think
he disapproves.
Then, let's listen
to Amy's opinion.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
我觉得他
没有反对。
那么，让我们听听
艾米的意见。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Mmm~ He's so polite!
He'll grow to be a wonderful Knight. And he's got such cute widdle cheeeeks~ Hee hee!
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
嗯~他真有礼貌！
他会长成一位出色的骑士。而且他那可爱的小脸颊~嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Mmm~ She should be great!
She's very courteous and also very cute, so a few more points! Heh~
I shouldn't be saying things like this!
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
嗯~她应该很棒！
她非常有礼貌，也非常可爱，所以再加几分！嘿~
我不应该说这样的话！

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Well...
A strange review,
but I believe
she approves.
Edmond, speak
your mind.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
好吧……
虽然评价很奇怪，
但我相信
她批准了。
埃德蒙，说出
你的想法。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
He seems a little rough, but something bright shines within him. With polish and refinement, his true value will shine forth
as the sun.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
他看起来有点粗糙，但他内心闪耀着光芒。经过打磨和提炼，他的真正价值将如太阳般闪耀。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
It's difficult to see, but there is a spiritual beauty within her. With polish and refinement, her true value will glow as resplendently
as the moon.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
虽然难以察觉，但她内心有一种精神之美。经过打磨和提炼，她的真正价值将如月亮般灿烂发光。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Lastly...
Gray. I would like
to hear your thoughts.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
最后……
格雷。我想
听听你的想法。

scripts.text:
[Gray]
A young {0} coming here with the determination to become a Knight is enough...
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
一位年轻的{0}带着成为骑士的决心来到这里，这就足够了……

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Everyone
has approved.
No one has opposed.
Then I shall tell
you my opinion.

与其他职业不同，骑士也可以使用长矛，并且拥有与长矛相关的技能。哪些技能不是学习骑乘攻击所必需的？

scripts.text: Pierce Lv.5
scripts.translation: 连刺攻击 Lv.5

scripts.text: Spear Stab Lv.3
scripts.translation: 长矛刺击 Lv.3

scripts.text: Spear Boomerang Lv.3
scripts.translation: 投掷长矛攻击 Lv.3

scripts.text: Peco Peco Ride Lv.1
scripts.translation: 骑乘术 Lv.1

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Wrong! You need to learn that to learn Brandish Spear! How can you not know about Knights if you want to become one?
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
错了！你需要学习那个才能学习骑乘攻击！如果你想成为骑士，怎么能不了解骑士呢？

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
If you aren't sure about anything, go into town and ask any Knight
for help. Come back after you've learned more about Knights.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
如果你有任何不确定的地方，去城镇里问问任何骑士寻求帮助。在你更多地了解骑士之后再回来！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Some Spears also have magical attributes, just like spells. Of the following, which can attack a Nightmare, which has the Ghost attribute?
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
有些长矛也像魔法一样具有属性。在以下选项中，哪一种可以攻击具有幽灵属性的梦魇？

scripts.text: Zephyrus
scripts.translation: 西风

scripts.text: Lance
scripts.translation: 长枪

scripts.text: Bill Guisarme
scripts.translation: 修尔特长矛

scripts.text: Crescent Scythe
scripts.translation: 死神之镰

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Wrong! You'll be doing absolutely no damage with that type of Spear! Come back after you've learned more about Knights!
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
错了！用那种类型的长矛你根本造不成任何伤害！在你更多地了解骑士之后再回来！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
If you have a question, just ask any Knight in town. This is basic knowledge for us!
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
如果你有问题，就去城镇里问问任何骑士。这对我们来说是基础知识！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
When you become a Knight you can ride a Peco Peco. However, your attack speed decreases once you're mounted on a Peco Peco.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
当你成为骑士时，你可以骑乘大嘴鸟。然而，一旦你骑上大嘴鸟，你的攻击速度就会降低。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
But, you can counter this speed decrease as you learn the Cavalier Mastery skill. What percentage of your normal attack speed will you have after learning Level 3 Cavalier Mastery?
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
但是，随着你学习骑兵修炼技能，你可以抵消这种速度降低。在学习了3级骑兵修炼后，你将拥有正常攻击速度的百分之多少？

scripts.text: 70 % of normal attack speed
scripts.translation: 正常攻击速度的 70 %

scripts.text: 80 % of normal attack speed
scripts.translation: 正常攻击速度的 80 %

scripts.text: 90 % of normal attack speed
scripts.translation: 正常攻击速度的 90 %

scripts.text: 100 % of normal attack speed
scripts.translation: 正常攻击速度的 100 %

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Wrong!
Don't bother riding a Peco Peco if you don't know about Cavalier Mastery!
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
错了！
如果你不了解骑兵修炼，就别费劲骑大嘴鸟了！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
You better come back after you've learned a little more about Knights!
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
你最好在对骑士有更多了解之后再回来！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Good, good...
I'm pretty sure you know a decent amount about Knights. Now, let me ask you some personal questions about Knights.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
好，好……
我很确定你对骑士有了相当的了解。现在，让我问你一些关于骑士的个人问题。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
What should you do when you run into a Novice asking for help in town?
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
当你在城镇里遇到寻求帮助的初心者时，你应该怎么做？

scripts.text: Tell the Novice of a reasonable hunting area.
scripts.translation: 告诉初心者一个合理的狩猎区域。

scripts.text: Let the Novice fight while you take the damage.
scripts.translation: 让初心者战斗，而你承受伤害。

scripts.text: Give the Novice a bunch of Zeny and items.
scripts.translation: 给初心者一堆泽尼和物品。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Of course, even a Novice needs to learn how to be independent. Giving good guidance to Novices is one of the best things we can do.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
当然，即使是初心者也需要学会独立。给予初心者良好的指导是我们能做的最好的事情之一。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
You have the wrong idea. Do you really believe that is helping the Novice? Give a man a fish, he will eat for a day. Teach him to fish, he will eat for a lifetime!
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
你的想法错了。你真的认为那是在帮助初心者吗？授人以鱼，不如授人以渔！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Do you really believe that this will truly help the poor Novice? It's generous but, they will not know the true value of zeny and items until they earn it themselves.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
你真的相信这会真正帮助可怜的初心者吗？虽然慷慨，但在他们自己赚取之前，他们不会知道泽尼和物品的真正价值。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Alright...
Now, how should
you act within
a party?
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
好吧……
现在，在
队伍中
你应该如何
行动？

scripts.text: Protect everyone in the front of the battle.
scripts.translation: 在战斗前方保护所有人。

scripts.text: Gather monsters and destroy them at once.
scripts.translation: 聚集魔物并一次性消灭它们。

scripts.text: Get as many items possible, at all cost.
scripts.translation: 不惜一切代价尽可能多地获取物品。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
That's it! Our strength and attacks are very important in a party. All Knights should engage in a battle with that mindset.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
就是这样！我们的力量和攻击在队伍中非常重要。所有骑士都应该以这种心态投入战斗。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Are you crazy? Don't you realize the flaw in that kind of thinking? You can't control large mobs. What if they kill you? Who will protect the innocent?
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
你疯了吗？你没意识到那种思维的缺陷吗？你无法控制大量的魔物群。如果它们杀了你怎么办？谁来保护无辜者？

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
I see your greed and we will have none of it here! It seems you do not truly care for others!
Get lost!
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
我看到了你的贪婪，我们这里不容忍这种行为！看来你并不真正关心他人！
滚开！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Lastly...
what's the most
important value
a Knight must have?
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
最后……
骑士必须拥有的
最重要价值观
是什么？

scripts.text: Honor
scripts.translation: 荣誉

scripts.text: Wealth
scripts.translation: 财富

scripts.text: Status
scripts.translation: 地位

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Right, above all else, Knights must be honorable! We live and die for honor! Always keep that in mind.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
对，最重要的是，骑士必须有荣誉感！我们为荣誉而生，为荣誉而死！永远记住这一点。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
You're scum! You strive to become a Knight for personal wealth? Get lost! We will not accept someone like you in our Chivalry!
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
你是人渣！你为了个人财富而努力成为骑士？滚开！我们骑士团不会接受像你这样的人！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
So you're trying to become famous through the Chivalry? That's pathetic. We won't accept someone like you in our Chivalry!
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
所以你想通过骑士团成名？真可悲。我们骑士团不会接受像你这样的人！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Well then,
this is the
end of my test.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
那么，
这就是
我测试的
结束。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
For your next
test, please go
see Sir Windsor.
He's very quiet,
but don't let that
get to you.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
对于你的下一次
测试，请去
见温莎爵士。
他很安静，
但别让那
影响你。

scripts.translation: 我想接受转职测试。

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，没什么。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Hey...
You already took my test, didn't you? You're done here. You should go visit Sir Windsor now...
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
嘿……
你已经接受过我的测试了，对吧？你在这里结束了。你现在应该去拜访温莎爵士……

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Hmmm...?
Alright.
It's just that
you had that
look on your
face.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
嗯……？
好吧。
只是因为你脸上
有那种
表情。

Well then,
go and see the
captain. We'll all
be there to evaluate
your performance.

去见
团长吧。我们都

你的表现。

...问题？

scripts.translation: 这是什么测试？

scripts.text: How do I take the test?
scripts.translation: 我该如何接受测试？

scripts.text: I'd like to leave.
scripts.translation: 我想离开。

scripts.text: No.

...

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...全部杀掉。

...
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]

[Sir Windsor]
...Three stages.
Beat them all.
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...三个阶段。
全部打败。

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
......3 minutes
for each stage.
scripts.translation:

......每个阶段
3分钟。

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
..........

[Sir Windsor]
...Go in the
waiting room.
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...去
等候室。

scripts.text:

will begin.
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

Amy Beatrice now.
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...现在去和
艾米·贝阿特丽丝谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Oh...!
I wonder, why
have you come
to visit me?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
哦……！
我在想，为什么
你来
拜访我？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Aww~
What a cute
little Novice!
Soooooo cute!
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
哇~
多么可爱的
小初心者！
太~~~~可爱了！

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Welcome to
the Prontera Chivalry~
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
欢迎来到
普隆德拉骑士团~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Ooh, you're
a Swordsman...?
Did you come to
change jobs to
a Knight?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
哦，你是
剑士……？
你是来
转职为
骑士的吗？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Hmmm?
Why did you
come to Amy?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
嗯？
你为什么
来找艾米？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You are a Knight and you are looking for a party in Morocc.
How would you go about doing so?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
你是一名骑士，正在莫洛克寻找队伍。
你会怎么做？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Wow~
Now it's time for
everyone to decide
on your job change!
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
哇~
现在是大家决定
你转职的时候了！

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You're not having
trouble as a Knight,
are you? Well, I think
you're doing well~
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
你作为骑士
没有遇到麻烦吧？
嗯，我觉得
你做得很好~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Of course~
You're a member of
the Prontera Chivalry~
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
当然~
你是
普隆德拉骑士团的
一员~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Heh heh...
Are you interested
in becoming a Knight
later on? You'd be
a great Knight~
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
嘿嘿……
你有兴趣
以后成为骑士吗？你会
成为一位伟大的骑士~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Remember, you're
going to be a Knight,
alright? Promise?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
记住，你
将要成为骑士，
好吗？答应我？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
We're only Knights,
but hope you enjoy
your stay here.
Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
我们只是骑士，
但希望你在这里
过得愉快。
嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
To apply, talk
to the captain
all the way over
there. Hee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
要申请，去那边
找团长
谈谈。嘻嘻~

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，没什么。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Mmm~
You applied to change jobs! Okay! You'll soon be a Knight with that kind of determination!
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
嗯~
你申请转职了！好吧！有了那种决心，你很快就会成为骑士！

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
But...
You have to go
to the other Knights
before talking to Amy.
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
但是……
在和艾米谈话之前，
你必须先去
其他骑士那里。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
I'd love to test
you from the beginning,
but I'm not allowed to.
Hee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
我很想从头开始
测试你，
但我不被允许。
嘻嘻~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Aww~
Alright...
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
哇~
好吧……

scripts.translation: 温莎爵士告诉我——

[Lady Amy]
Oh!
No need to say
anything more.
Welcome! It's time
to take Amy's test!
scripts.translation:

不用再说

欢迎！是时候
接受艾米的测试了！

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]

a proud Lady Knight of the Prontera Chivalry. Amy's test will test your etiquette as a Knight~
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
我叫艾米·贝阿特丽丝，
是普隆德拉骑士团的一位骄傲的女骑士。艾米的测试将测试你作为骑士的礼仪~

I ask a question. Your etiquette will be judged on your answers.
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
我会讲一个故事，每当我提问时，你选择一个答案。你的礼仪将根据你的回答来评判。

So listen carefully
and answer as if you're
already a Knight, okay?
scripts.translation:

并像你已经
是骑士一样回答，好吗？

let's begin!
scripts.translation:

那么，
开始吧！

好吧~

what you did wrong
last time? If you
fail again, I'm going

做错的教训吗？如果
你再失败，我就要
生气了！

Well then,
let's begin!
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
所以仔细听，
并像你是
骑士一样回答。
那么，
开始吧！

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You are a Knight and you are looking for a party in Morocc.
How would you go about doing so?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
你是一名骑士，正在莫洛克寻找队伍。
你会怎么做？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Aww...
Alright~
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
哇……
好吧~

scripts.text:
You are a Knight and you are looking for a party in Morocc.
How would you go about doing so?
scripts.translation:
你是一名骑士，正在莫洛克寻找队伍。
你会怎么做？

scripts.text: Shout out that you are looking for a party.
scripts.translation: 大喊你在寻找队伍。

scripts.text: Open a chat room and wait.
scripts.translation: 开设聊天室并等待。

scripts.text: Look for people seeking Knights.
scripts.translation: 寻找寻求骑士的人。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You have formed a party with equal leveled players. There's a Priest, a Wizard, a Hunter, an Assassin, and a Blacksmith...
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
你和同等级的玩家组成了一个队伍。有一位牧师、一位巫师、一位猎人、一位刺客和一位铁匠……

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
The six of you decide to go hunt and have decided to go to the Pyramids.
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
你们六人决定去狩猎，并决定前往金字塔。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You reach Level 4
of the Pyramids
with your party.
What should you do?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
你和队伍到达了
金字塔的
第4层。
你应该怎么做？

scripts.text: Check out the area and plan ahead.
scripts.translation: 检查区域并提前计划。

scripts.text: Gather monsters for your party members.
scripts.translation: 为你的队员聚集魔物。

scripts.text: Lead the party slowly at the front.
scripts.translation: 在前方缓慢带领队伍。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
But some rude players came with a group of monsters and disappeared! What should you do?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
但是一些粗鲁的玩家带着一群魔物出现了然后消失了！你应该怎么做？

scripts.text: Keep the monsters from reaching the party.
scripts.translation: 阻止魔物接近队伍。

scripts.text: Defend while the party retreats.
scripts.translation: 在队伍撤退时进行防御。

scripts.text: Run away on your Peco Peco.
scripts.translation: 骑着你的大嘴鸟逃跑。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Luckily, you all lived through the crisis. But as you walk, you find a person, who is not in your party, collapsed on the ground.
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
幸运的是，你们都度过了危机。但当你们行走时，你发现一个不在你队伍里的人倒在地上。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
The person is asking politely for help. What should you do?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
那个人礼貌地请求帮助。你应该怎么做？

scripts.text: Ask your party's Priest to help.
scripts.translation: 请求队伍的牧师帮忙。

scripts.text: Say you will help for Zeny.
scripts.translation: 说你会为了泽尼提供帮助。

scripts.text: Ignore and move on.
scripts.translation: 无视并继续前进。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You must bid farewell to your party members because you must go somewhere else.
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
因为你必须去别的地方，所以你必须向队伍成员告别。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
But you find
a rare item during
the battle. What
should you do?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
但你在战斗中
发现了一件稀有物品。
你应该
怎么做？

scripts.text: Give it to who deserves it the most.
scripts.translation: 把它给最值得的人。

scripts.text: Pretend like nothing happened and keep it.
scripts.translation: 假装什么都没发生并保留它。

scripts.text: Decide with party who gets it.
scripts.translation: 与队伍决定谁得到它。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You end up with the item and you go to Prontera to sell it. There are many people with shops and chat rooms opened selling items.
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
你得到了这件物品，你去普隆德拉出售它。那里有很多人开着商店和聊天室出售物品。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
What should you
do to sell your item?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
你应该
怎么做来出售你的物品？

scripts.text: Shout out loud to everyone.
scripts.translation: 向每个人大声喊叫。

scripts.text: Open a chat room and wait.
scripts.translation: 开设聊天室并等待。

scripts.text: Inquire if there is anyone that is interested.
scripts.translation: 询问是否有人感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
While you are waiting,
someone comes and begs
for items and zeny.
What do you do?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
当你等待时，
有人过来乞求
物品和泽尼。
你做什么？

scripts.text: Give them some Zeny and items.
scripts.translation: 给他们一些泽尼和物品。

scripts.text: Simply ignore them.
scripts.translation: 直接无视他们。

scripts.text: Give suggestions for a place to hunt.
scripts.translation: 建议一个狩猎地点。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Now you decide to go to the Hidden Temple by yourself. You happily ride on your Peco Peco.
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
现在你决定独自去隐藏神殿。你快乐地骑着你的大嘴鸟。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
But you run into
someone that is lost.
What should you do?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
但你遇到了
一个迷路的人。
你应该怎么做？

scripts.text: Tell the person how to reach the exit.
scripts.translation: 告诉那人如何到达出口。

scripts.text: Lead the person to the exit.
scripts.translation: 带领那人到出口。

scripts.text: Give a Butterfly Wing.
scripts.translation: 给一个蝴蝶翅膀。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You've been hunting for a while, and now you're low on HP!
It's red now, which is very dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
你已经狩猎了一段时间，现在你的HP很低！
现在是红色了，非常危险。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Ah, then a Priest
happens to walk by.
How would you ask
the Priest for a Heal?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
啊，这时一位牧师
碰巧路过。
你会如何请求
牧师使用治愈术？

scripts.text: Would it be possible to get a heal please?
scripts.translation: 请问可以帮我治愈一下吗？

scripts.text: Can I have a heal?
scripts.translation: 能帮我治愈一下吗？

scripts.text: Heal plz!!
scripts.translation: 治愈术 请！！

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You are now very
exhausted and it's time
to go back to town.
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
你现在非常
疲惫，是时候
回城镇了。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You then find
a rare item on
the street.
What should
you do?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
然后你在
街上发现
一件稀有物品。
你应该
怎么做？

scripts.text: Pick it up and keep it.
scripts.translation: 捡起来并保留。

scripts.text: Ask around to find the owner.
scripts.translation: 四处询问以找到失主。

scripts.text: Simply walk by.
scripts.translation: 直接走过。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Okay,
that was the
end of my test!
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
好了，
这就是
我测试的
结束！

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Well done, that kind of mentality is needed for a Knight! For your next test, visit Sir Edmond, please~
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
干得好，骑士需要这种心态！对于你的下一次测试，请去拜访埃德蒙爵士~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Well, it wasn't perfect,
but I think you know enough
about etiquette to be
a fine Knight.
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
嗯，虽然不完美，
但我认为你足够了解
礼仪，可以成为
一名优秀的骑士。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Mmm...
To be honest, I don't think your attitude is good enough to be a Knight quite yet.
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
嗯……
老实说，我认为你的态度还不足以成为骑士。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
I'll have nice comments about you for the captain. Do well on the tests you have left, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
我会向团长说你的好话。在剩下的测试中好好表现，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Now, it's time for you to go to Sir Edmond for your next test. Do well on the rest of your tests. You better promise~
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
现在，是你去埃德蒙爵士那里进行下一次测试的时候了。在剩下的测试中好好表现。你最好答应我~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
If you really act like that, everyone will think Knights are rude! Think about how you answered my questions and come again later.
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
如果你真的那样做，每个人都会认为骑士很粗鲁！想想你是如何回答我的问题的，稍后再来。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
If you want,
I'll let you
retake the test, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
如果你愿意，
我可以让你
重考，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You have to go to
Sir Edmond for your
next test, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
你必须去
埃德蒙爵士那里进行
下一次测试，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Let's go talk to our
captain. Don't worry
too much. It should
be okay.
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
我们去和我们的
团长谈谈吧。别太
担心。应该
没问题。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You still have
other tests to take.
Hurry and finish~
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
你还有
其他测试要参加。
快点完成~

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Think of your
mind as if it were
flowing water.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
把你的
心想象成
流水。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Trees with deep roots don't sway with the wind. The fact that powerful skills must be built on strong basics is immutable...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
根深蒂固的树不会随风摇摆。强大的技能必须建立在坚实的基础上，这是不可改变的……

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Everything in this world exists in harmony. Living without disrupting this harmony is the right way to live...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
世间万物和谐共存。在不破坏这种和谐的情况下生活是正确的生存之道……

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Those with ominous thoughts will only dream such dreams. It's better to have no dreams at all than to have dreams of sadness and despair.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
心怀不祥念头的人只会做那样的梦。与其做悲伤和绝望的梦，不如不做梦。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
What is it...
Wandering Swordman?
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
什么事……
流浪的剑士？

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
What is it...
Wandering Swordman.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
什么事……
流浪的剑士。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
I have seen your character for myself. It is now time for you to take the last test. Go and speak
to Sir Gray...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
我已经亲自见识了你的品格。现在是你接受最后一次测试的时候了。去和
格雷爵士谈谈……

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Go and speak
to our captain.
The time has come
for all of us to
evaluate your
performance.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
去和
我们的团长谈谈。
是我们大家
评估你
表现的
时候了。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Flowing water
avoids obstacles,
going on its way...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
流水
避开障碍，
继续前行……

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Knights must be
able to pass things,
like calm water, in
any situation.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
骑士必须能够
像平静的水一样，
在任何情况下
穿过事物。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Your future
can even be
decided now...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
你的未来
甚至可以在
现在决定……

scripts.text: I would like to take the test to change jobs.
scripts.translation: 我想接受转职测试。

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，没什么。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
A seed must first be nestled
in the earth before the seed may sprout. Then, the sprout must grow leaves before its buds blossom into flowers...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
种子必须先埋入土中才能发芽。然后，嫩芽必须长出叶子，花蕾才能绽放成花朵……

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
If not...
The flower will
be incomplete.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
否则……
花朵将
不完整。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Go to the others
first, so that you
may find your path...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
先去其他人那里，
以便你
能找到你的道路……

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
The life that you
want will soon be
before your eyes.
Everything will
come in perfect
order.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
你想要的生活
很快就会出现在
你眼前。
一切都将
按完美的
顺序到来。

scripts.text: Lady Amy sent me.
scripts.translation: 艾米女士派我来的。

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，没什么。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
It is now time to take my test. Please do your best, as you have done on the other tests.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
现在是接受我测试的时候了。请像在之前的测试中一样尽力而为。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
My name is
Edmond Groster.
I am a member of
the Prontera Chivalry.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
我叫
埃德蒙·格罗斯特。
我是
普隆德拉骑士团的
一员。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Knights are in the position for others to follow. Therefore, you must modestly think about the world's order and have the personality to fit the role you will play.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
骑士处于让别人追随的位置。因此，你必须谦虚地思考世界的秩序，并拥有适合你将扮演角色的个性。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
You must not make careless decisions. Your will should bend as the reeds or be as firm as stone when the situation calls for it.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
你不能做出轻率的决定。你的意志应该像芦苇一样弯曲，或在情况需要时像石头一样坚定。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
You must not kill monsters without reason and not take joy in doing so. Take this time to quietly think about this on your own...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
你不能无缘无故地杀死魔物，也不应从中获得乐趣。利用这段时间静静地独自思考……

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Then, we shall
begin the test.
Keep in mind
the quality of
reverence.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
那么，我们将
开始测试。
牢记
敬畏的品质。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
The life you want
will soon be before
your eyes.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
你想要的生活
很快就会出现在
你眼前。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to...
scripts.translation: 对不起，我不是故意的……

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，没什么。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
You were too careless in the last test. A Knight's sword exists to protect others, not to torment weaker monsters.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
你在上一次测试中太粗心了。骑士的剑是为了保护他人，而不是为了折磨较弱的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
In a world where everything exists in harmony, you can't have humans continuously destroying without purpose. This principle applies to the real world, not to this test alone.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
在一个万物和谐共存的世界里，人类不能持续无目的地破坏。这一原则不仅适用于这次测试，也适用于现实世界。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
The test
shall begin.
Show me your
patience...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
测试
即将开始。
向我展示你的
耐心……

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
The life that you
want will soon be
before your eyes.
Everything will
come in perfect
order.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
你想要的生活
很快就会出现在
你眼前。
一切都将
按完美的
顺序到来。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
The glint of light
that shines off this blade cannot be put into words. This is the weapon every Knight must have.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
这把刀刃上闪烁的光芒无法用言语形容。这是每位骑士必须拥有的武器。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Believe it
or not, I was
once a Novice
as well.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
信不信由你，我
曾经也是
一名初心者。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Young one,
use your time
wisely.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
年轻人，
明智地利用
你的时间。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Oh...
A young Swordman.
Yes, what can
I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
哦……
一位年轻的剑士。
是的，我能
为你做些什么？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Ah, you again.
What brings you
to me?
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
啊，又是你。
什么风把你
吹到我这里？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
[Sir Gray]
To become stronger, you say?
Yes, Knights are indeed strong.
But why gain strength?
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
[格雷]
想变得更强，是吗？
是的，骑士确实很强。
但为什么要获得力量？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
[Sir Gray]
Ah, to help your guild, or maybe even your party. Our wise and benevolent King Tristram the 3rd gave us these golden words...
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
[格雷]
啊，为了帮助你的公会，甚至是你的队伍。我们睿智仁慈的特里斯特拉姆三世国王给了我们这些金玉良言……

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
[Sir Gray]
Satisfaction, you say.
It seems like you are
already a fine Swordman.
Is there a particular reason you wish to be a Knight?
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
[格雷]
满足感，是吗？
看来你已经
是一名优秀的剑士了。
你有什么特别的原因想成为骑士吗？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
[Sir Gray]
I understand your thoughts,
but there are those who wish to
become Knights without thinking.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
[格雷]
我理解你的想法，
但有些人想成为
骑士却不经思考。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I told you
to go to
the captain.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
我告诉过你
去见
团长。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Oh...
A young Swordman.
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
哦……
一位年轻的剑士。
我能为你做些什么？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Yes...
^3355FFClaymore^000000!
Every Knight
would want one!
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
是的……
^3355FF阔剑^000000！
每位骑士
都想要一把！

scripts.text: About ^3355FFClaymore^000000
Buy Claymore
scripts.translation: 购买阔剑

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Claymore, one of the best among the famous swords you can attain in Rune-Midgarts' Prontera!! Its value is priceless when considered by a Knight.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
阔剑，是你在卢恩·米德加兹的普隆德拉可以获得的著名宝剑中最好的一把！！对于骑士来说，它的价值是无价的。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Now, the Prontera Chivalry is making these fabulous Claymores. For Knights, they are only ^3355FF74,000^000000 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
现在，普隆德拉骑士团正在制作这些精美的阔剑。对于骑士来说，它们只需 ^3355FF74,000^000000 泽尼。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
But not only that, you need
1 ^3355FFSteel^000000 because of the Claymore's characteristics. If you like, I can create one for you. For the honor of the Prontera Chivalry!
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
但不止如此，由于阔剑的特性，你还需要 1 个 ^3355FF钢铁^000000。如果你愿意，我可以为你制作一把。为了普隆德拉骑士团的荣誉！

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Oh no...
It seems that you are carrying too many things. You don't have enough space for a heavy Claymore in your inventory.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
哦不……
看来你携带的东西太多了。你的背包里没有足够的空间放一把沉重的阔剑。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Why don't you
go and organize
your items first.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
你为什么不去
先整理一下
你的物品。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
You are ready!
You must know the
true value of
a Claymore!
I shall make
it right now!!
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
你准备好了！
你一定知道
阔剑的
真正价值！
我现在就
制作它！！

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
The basics of
making the Claymore
is easy. Watch~!
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
制作阔剑的
基础很简单。看~！

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Stir Stir*^000000
^3355FF*Ooncha Ooncha*^000000

[Sir Gray]
Okay, it's ready!
Every Knight's pride:
a fine ^3355FFClaymore^000000.
You attained a reliable item.
It'll be a good companion on your adventures.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
好了，准备好了！
每位骑士的骄傲：
一把精美的 ^3355FF阔剑^000000。
你获得了一件可靠的物品。
它将成为你冒险中的好伙伴。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I realize you may really want a Claymore, but I can't make it without the materials.
^3355FF74,000 zeny^000000 and ^3355FF1 Steel!^000000.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
我意识到你可能真的很想要一把阔剑，但没有材料我无法制作。
^3355FF74,000 泽尼^000000 和 ^3355FF1 个钢铁！^000000

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Come back when
you have everything
ready. I shall be
waiting...
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
等你准备好一切
再回来。我将
等待……

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Any Knight should be able to wield a Claymore as if it were an extension of their body. I used to look forward to brandishing my Claymore in battle...
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
任何骑士都应该能够像使用身体延伸部分一样挥舞阔剑。我曾经期待在战斗中挥舞我的阔剑……

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I never really planned to become a Knight, but I did decide to become a strong person. Somehow, along my journeys, I ended up joining the Prontera Chivalry. Ha ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
我从未真正计划成为骑士，但我确实决定成为一个强大的人。不知何故，在我的旅程中，我最终加入了普隆德拉骑士团。哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
Young one,
use your time
wisely.
scripts.translation:
年轻人，
明智地利用
你的时间。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
No point in
harboring regret
once time has passed.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
时间流逝后，
怀有遗憾
毫无意义。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
No point in
harboring regret
once time has passed.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
时间流逝后，
怀有遗憾
毫无意义。

scripts.text: I would like to take the test to change jobs.
scripts.translation: 我想接受转职测试。

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，没什么。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Hoho, I see.
So you took
everyone else's
test?
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
呵呵，我明白了。
所以你接受了
其他人的
测试？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Then shall
we begin mine?
It's not really
a test though.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
那么我们要
开始我的吗？
其实这不算
真正的测试。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Let's talk
casually,
shall we?
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
让我们随便
聊聊，
好吗？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
First...
Why did you
decide to become
a Knight?
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
首先……
你为什么
决定成为
骑士？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Take care!
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
保重！

scripts.text: I've been thinking a lot.
scripts.translation: 我一直在思考很多。

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，没什么。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Is that so...
I wonder if you
truly have...
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
是吗……
我想知道你是否
真的思考过……

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Then...
Like last time,
I will ask again...
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
那么……
像上次一样，
我再问一次……

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
First...
Why did you
decide to become
a Knight?
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
首先……
你为什么
决定成为
骑士？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Take care!
Health is
every man's
treasure!
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
保重！
健康是
每个人的
宝藏！

scripts.text: To become stronger...
scripts.translation: 为了变得更强……

scripts.text: To help my guild...
scripts.translation: 为了帮助我的公会……

scripts.text: Because I'm unsatisfied with myself right now...
scripts.translation: 因为我对现在的自己不满意……

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
To become stronger, you say?
Yes, Knights are indeed strong.
But why gain strength?
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
想变得更强，是吗？
是的，骑士确实很强。
但为什么要获得力量？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Is it to show off to others? To attain fame? Or do you have a diferent reason? What do you think is so good about gaining strength as a Knight?
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
是为了向别人炫耀吗？为了获得名声？还是你有不同的理由？你认为作为骑士获得力量有什么好处？

scripts.text: Gain wealth and fame.
scripts.translation: 获得财富和名声。

scripts.text: I can protect myself.
scripts.translation: 我可以保护自己。

scripts.text: I can protect others.
scripts.translation: 我可以保护他人。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Of course, wealth and fame have their place in the world. But we as Knights must live for higher virtues.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
当然，财富和名声在世界上有一席之地。但我们作为骑士必须为更高的美德而活。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Good thinking. You must first be able to protect yourself in order to protect others. To this end, you must constantly train, and never give in to laziness.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
想法很好。你必须首先能够保护自己，才能保护他人。为此，你必须不断训练，绝不向懒惰屈服。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Ah, a wonderful idea. A Knight's strength must be used to protect the weak and defend righteousness.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
啊，一个绝妙的主意。骑士的力量必须用于保护弱者和捍卫正义。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Sadly, there are a few Knights who shame us by forgetting the ideals that should be basic to Knighthood...
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
遗憾的是，有少数骑士忘记了骑士道的基本理想，使我们蒙羞……

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Ah, to help your guild, or maybe even your party. Our wise and benevolent King Tristram the 3rd gave us these golden words...
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
啊，为了帮助你的公会，甚至是你的队伍。我们睿智仁慈的特里斯特拉姆三世国王给了我们这些金玉良言……

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
^8B7500Beyond the calm river, lies a dangerous waterfall. Therefore, you must always be prepared for everything...^000000
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
^8B7500平静的河流之外，隐藏着危险的瀑布。因此，你必须时刻为一切做好准备……^000000

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
So how do you
think you can
help your guild?
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
那么你认为
你可以如何
帮助你的公会？

scripts.text: My guild needs me.
scripts.translation: 我的公会需要我。

scripts.text: I can help gather funds for my guild.
scripts.translation: 我可以帮助公会筹集资金。

scripts.text: I can protect my guild members.
scripts.translation: 我可以保护我的公会成员。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Anyone, anywhere in this world,
has a place where they are needed. Never neglect someone in need, even if he is not a guild member.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
在这个世界上，任何人都有被需要的地方。永远不要忽视有需要的人，即使他不是公会成员。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Of course wealth is important.
But we Knights must live for higher virtues.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
当然财富很重要。
但我们骑士必须为更高的美德而活。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Ah, a wonderful idea. A Knight's strength must be used to protect the weak and defend righteousness.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
啊，一个绝妙的主意。骑士的力量必须用于保护弱者和捍卫正义。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Sadly, there are a few Knights who shame us by forgetting the ideals that should be basic to Knighthood...
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
遗憾的是，有少数骑士忘记了骑士道的基本理想，使我们蒙羞……

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Satisfaction, you say.
It seems like you are
already a fine Swordman.
Is there a particular reason you wish to be a Knight?
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
满足感，是吗？
看来你已经
是一名优秀的剑士了。
你有什么特别的原因想成为骑士吗？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I don't know about
Swordmen, but Knights do not allow self-indulgence. There are those so obsessed with gaining strength that they cannot control themselves.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
我不了解剑士，但骑士不允许自我放纵。有些人如此痴迷于获得力量，以至于无法控制自己。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
So...
What part of yourself
are you not satisfied
with right now?
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
那么……
你现在对
自己的哪方面
不满意？

scripts.text: Skills.
scripts.translation: 技能。

scripts.text: Goal.
scripts.translation: 目标。

scripts.text: Appearance.
scripts.translation: 外貌。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Skill is something you gain with experience as a Knight. It cannot be your highest goal. Otherwise, you'll never be satisfied as a Knight.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
技能是作为骑士通过经验获得的。它不能是你的最高目标。否则，你永远不会对作为骑士感到满意。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I see...
Always having a goal is very important. You may be full of ideas upon becoming a Knight, but that may change with time.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
我明白了……
始终拥有目标非常重要。成为骑士后，你可能会充满想法，但这可能会随时间改变。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Oh no...
What you see isn't what really counts. A Swordman may be stronger than a Knight, and even Knight may grow weak if he becomes lazy.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
哦不……
你看到的并不是真正重要的。剑士可能比骑士更强，甚至骑士如果变得懒惰也会变弱。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I understand your thoughts,
but there are those who wish to
become Knights without thinking.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
我理解你的想法，
但有些人想成为
骑士却不经思考。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Those are the ones who instigate problems and shame the honor of Knights, bringing irreversible results.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
正是这些人引发问题，羞辱骑士的荣誉，带来不可逆转的后果。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
The same goes for you as well. Once you become a Knight, you can never become a Swordman again. The duties and responsibilities of a Knight will always be with you.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
这也适用于你。一旦你成为骑士，你就再也无法成为剑士了。骑士的职责和责任将永远伴随着你。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
If you become a Knight right away, what are you going to do first?
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
如果你立即成为骑士，你打算首先做什么？

scripts.text: I am going to go straight to battle.
scripts.translation: 我打算直接去战斗。

scripts.text: There are those waiting for me.
scripts.translation: 有人在等我。

scripts.text: I will learn more about Knights.
scripts.translation: 我将更多地了解骑士。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Battle...?
And then?
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
战斗……？
然后呢？

scripts.text: I will grow within a short period of time.
scripts.translation: 我将在短时间内成长。

scripts.text: I would like to test my ability as a Knight.
scripts.translation: 我想测试我作为骑士的能力。

scripts.text: I would like to go to more challenging places.
scripts.translation: 我想去更具挑战性的地方。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Don't be in too much of a hurry to become strong. Even if you become
a Knight, you are still yourself.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
不要太急于变强。即使你成为
骑士，你仍然是你自己。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Testing yourself is a good thing. It's okay to be happy about how you change, but don't forget about the true qualities of being a Knight.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
测试自己是一件好事。为自己的变化感到高兴是可以的，但不要忘记作为骑士的真正品质。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Even if you become a Knight, you are not changing your inner self. No need to overwork yourself.
Relax and take things step by step.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
即使你成为骑士，你也没有改变你的内在自我。无需过度劳累自己。
放松，一步一步来。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Who is
waiting for you?
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
谁在
等你？

scripts.text: My friends.
scripts.translation: 我的朋友。

scripts.text: My Guild members.
scripts.translation: 我的公会成员。

scripts.text: My Lover.
scripts.translation: 我的爱人。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I see, they would share in the joy of your achievements. Don't ever lose your kind heart, and always give help to your friends.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
我明白了，他们会分享你成就的喜悦。永远不要失去你的善良之心，并总是帮助你的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Those who would share in your happiness and hardship. As a Knight, you must always protect them.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
那些与你分享快乐和苦难的人。作为骑士，你必须永远保护他们。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Oh, youth!
Becoming a Knight
for your beloved!
Always protect {0}...
Even at the sacrifice
of your own life!
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
哦，青春！
为了你爱的人
成为骑士！
永远保护{0}……
即使牺牲
你自己的生命！

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Also...
Love them forever.
Sincere affection
is hard to find.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
还有……
永远爱他们。
真挚的感情
很难找到。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Good attitude...
What do you plan
on learning?
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
态度很好……
你计划
学习什么？

scripts.text: Comfortable places for Knights to go...
scripts.translation: 骑士可以去舒适的地方……

scripts.text: The different paths of a Knight...
scripts.translation: 骑士的不同道路……

scripts.text: Ways to get more money as a Knight...
scripts.translation: 作为骑士获得更多金钱的方法……

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
There are many places that are comfortable or uncomfortable in this world. However Knights must
be able to survive anywhere.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
这个世界上有许多舒适或不舒适的地方。然而，骑士必须能够在任何地方生存。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
There are many similar Knights outside in the world. Think of them as your seniors and ask many questions.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
外面世界上有许多类似的骑士。把他们当作你的前辈，多问问题。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Oh no. Do you hold wealth as a priority of being a Knight? We're not meant to be that way. Come again when you have thought
more about it...
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
哦不。你把财富视为成为骑士的优先事项吗？我们不是为了那样而存在的。等你多想清楚后再来……

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Oh no, we've been
talking too much...
I apologize for
keeping you here
for so long.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
哦不，我们谈得
太多了……
抱歉让你
在这里待了
这么久。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I enjoyed talking with you. You remind me of myself as a young recruit. Shall we talk to the captain and decide on your
job change?
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
我喜欢和你交谈。你让我想起了我年轻时作为新兵的样子。我们去和团长谈谈，决定你的
转职好吗？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Don't worry too
much, I have a very
high opinion of you.
Now, go~
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
别太担心，我对你
评价很高。
现在，去吧~

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I enjoyed speaking with you. You can think about the principles of Knighthood more once you become a Knight.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
我喜欢和你交谈。成为骑士后，你可以更多地思考骑士道的原则。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Then, shall we go to the captain and decide on your job change? Don't worry too much. You are good enough to be a Knight!
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
那么，我们去团长那里决定你的转职好吗？别太担心。你足够优秀，可以成为骑士！

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I enjoyed talking with you. Although, there were some
things that bothered me...
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
我喜欢和你交谈。不过，有些事情让我有点在意……

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
You should go
to the captain
so we can decide
on your job change.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
你应该去
团长那里
以便我们决定
你的转职。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Don't worry too much, coming to take my test means the others have acknowledged you as well.
Go now...!
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
别太担心，来接受我的测试意味着其他人也认可了你。
现在去吧……！

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Conversing
with young ones
is always enjoyable...
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
和年轻人
交谈
总是令人愉快……

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
But it seems as though your dream is elsewhere, or that your focus is hazy. Spend more time as a Swordman, and come back
to me later.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
但似乎你的梦想在别处，或者你的焦点模糊。多花点时间作为剑士，稍后再
回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
If you truly wish to become a Knight, you must change your outlook first. Then, we shall see.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
如果你真的想成为骑士，你必须先改变你的看法。然后，我们再看。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Everyone will
carefully make
their decision,
so go now!
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
大家都会
仔细做出
决定，
所以现在去吧！

scripts.text: I would like to take the test to change jobs.
scripts.translation: 我想接受转职测试。

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，没什么。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Hoho~
There are many
other younger
Knights in here.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
呵呵~
这里有很多
更年轻的
骑士。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
If you talk
to all of them,
I may review
you as well.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
如果你和他们
都谈谈，
我也许会
重新评估
你。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Take care!
Health is
every man's
treasure!
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
保重！
健康是
每个人的
宝藏！
